about_the_game:
This game is something you haven't played before, something that can surprise you with its uniqueness.

The ball — may surprise you with its unique design and unique level construction. Activators, teleporters, satellites, moving platforms and unique decorations are waiting for you in them.

Locations:

30+ levels with different uniqueness and linear play. Each location will greet you with colors, and the paths may not be easy, consisting of several tasks, do not forget that this is a puzzle and also a maze.

Complexity:

No need to worry, all levels are moderately complicated, and the difficulty increases as you play. You will be greeted by a simple interface, intuitive training that clearly shows what is responsible for what.

Goal:

To reach the end, you should look for activators, teleporters, they all lead to your goal.

Colorful:

The game levels are colorful and intense.

The ball uses the Unreal® engine Engine. Unreal® is a trademark or registered trademark of Epic Games, Inc. in the United States of America and other countries.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT 8GB or similar graphics cards from other series

short_description: The ball is a single—player platformer game, featuring mazes and level adventures. You will also be greeted by the colorful and diverse levels created from spheres and hemispheres, which are seasoned with casualness. All this is waiting for you in the game!
